# Survey apps, examples and guides since 13.1 for the 13.2 notes

## Context

This is a survey leaf of #14800. It follows the [survey method](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/14800#issuecomment-5792321883) (@tobiu, 2026-09-23: the window is roughly 1,500 PRs and the split moved the Brain and the Fleet Manager out of scope).

This leaf covers **apps, examples and guides**: 44 merged PRs, listed in the first comment. It holds PRs scoped `portal`, `examples`, `docs`, `learn`, … and, for PRs whose title names no scope, those touching the other `apps/`, `examples/`, `learn/` or the `docs/` API app. Dock guides (`docs(dock)`) belong to #19101.

## The Problem

A reader's first question after "what changed" is "what can I try". The v13.1 notes review asked for exactly that, as an actionability section. Nothing in the 13.2 draft answers it yet:
- which examples and apps are new or newly working;
- which guides are new or rewritten (for example, the Dock Layouts guide series #17540);
- what the portal gained.

## The Architectural Reality

The population rule and the Tier 1–3 rubric are in the method comment. Dock and Workstation apps and examples belong to the dock leaf.

## The Fix

Read the slice, then write two parts of `resources/content/release-notes/v13.2.0.md`:
- the **Apps, examples and guides** digest section;
- a **What you can do with 13.2** section: runnable examples, apps and guides, each with its link.

Add at most two chapter nominations.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 Every PR in the slice is read, and the section's counts line states read / listed / excluded, with the reason.
- [ ] AC-2 Each Tier 1–3 item is one line: what changed, who notices it, and its PR or ticket.
- [ ] AC-3 Every item in the "What you can do with 13.2" section is runnable or readable at its link on `dev`.
- [ ] AC-4 At most two chapter nominations, each with evidence and its mining state.
- [ ] AC-5 Reviewed cross-family.

## Out of Scope

- The portal's deploy and content scope (#19047, D#19051).
- Dock and Workstation apps and examples, which have their own leaf.

## Related

#14800 · PR #19091 · #17540

## Survey disposition — 44/44 PRs read

The live list on this issue contains 44 merged PRs. I checked their merged source/body and classified each once; the six buckets below are disjoint and cover all 44 (12 + 12 + 1 + 8 + 10 + 1). The staging note at `resources/content/release-notes/v13.2.0.md` carries the ten grouped reader lines from the 12 retained PRs.

| Disposition | Count | PRs |
|---|---:|---|
| Retained here: reader-facing app/example/guide change | 12 | `#17437`, `#17487`, `#17902`, `#17905`, `#17941`, `#17959`, `#18133`, `#18337`, `#18774`, `#18830`, `#18851`, `#19021` |
| Dock/Workstation → survey `#19101` | 12 | `#15021`, `#15471`, `#17515`, `#17520`, `#17572`, `#17632`, `#17986`, `#18094`, `#18140`, `#18431`, `#18543`, `#18550` |
| Splitter → components survey `#19099` | 1 | `#17822` |
| Split-out Brain/Fleet, outside Engine notes | 8 | `#14732`, `#15546`, `#15771`, `#16037`, `#16291`, `#16441`, `#17110`, `#18350` |
| Internal, editorial or organism-wide, not a reader action in this Engine slice | 10 | `#14904`, `#15497`, `#15553`, `#16072`, `#16082`, `#17612`, `#17622`, `#18172`, `#18238`, `#18811` |
| Contributor-template process, outside this digest | 1 | `#19035` |

Boundary decisions: `#14904` rebuilt Neo's whole-organism front door, so it stays out of the Engine 13.2 digest; `#18337` is retained because its five-repository map tells an Engine user where the post-split source now lives. `#17520` changes a published 13.1 example path, and `#18830` removes supplied Google Maps keys; both were forwarded to the upgrade-path author on [PR #19113](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/19113#issuecomment-5794648274). The merged `#19035` template says `Resolves #` for one fully delivered issue; its PR body describes a prior `Closes`/`Refs` shape, so the merged diff governed this bucket.

No chapter nomination from this slice: the multi-PR Dock guide/demo arc is in `#19101` for its own mining. This digest uses the corpus snapshot at `267fedf`; counts will be refreshed at the cut.
